subject: Service map & data paths — follow-up from demo
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Connors <sara.connors@avahealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Service map & data paths — follow-up from demo

Hi Sara — thanks again for the demo time earlier. Quick recap and immediate asks so your security team has what they need: 

1) Demo highlights (one-liner): Redwood can route inference to a dedicated private pool and provide per-route auditing + token-level cost breakdowns.
2) Security/compliance items you flagged: SOC 2 status, data residency, and a concise list of who we share data with (cloud, logging, analytics).

Action items I promised:
- Share current SOC 2 report summary and a one-page data flow diagram (I attached a draft service map).
- Start the vendor security questionnaire (you mentioned a PDF) and let us know whether you prefer our answers inline or a redline.
- Confirm whether AVA requires HIPAA-specific wording or a BA agreement template.

I cc'd Neha (security) so we can get the SOC 2 summary and the cloud roster to you. Also attaching the short demo recording for your product team.

Attachments: demo-recording.mp4 (link stub), service-map-draft.png

Next steps: If you can share the vendor questionnaire PDF, we'll start populating it and aim to return a first pass within 3 business days.

Thanks —
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Executive | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0186

From: Sara Connors <sara.connors@avahealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eric Ma <sec-qa@avahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:10:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Service map & data paths — follow-up from demo

Camila — appreciate the recap and the recording. Attaching our standard vendor security questionnaire (PDF). A few clarifications from our side before we hand this to procurement/security:

- SOC 2: we require either a current SOC 2 Type II report or a SOC 2 self-attestation plus a remediation plan if no Type II is available. Can you confirm which you have?
- Data residency: for PHI we need to know where inference token payloads may be stored (logs, KV cache, analytics) and whether those can be restricted to the US.
- Third-party services: please provide an inventory of cloud and third-party services that will process AVA data (compute, object storage, logging, monitoring).

I've looped in Eric from our security team (sec-qa@avahealth.com). Please send your answers and any attachments to both of us. We'll prefer inline answers in the attached PDF but can accept a Drive link if the attachments are large.

Thanks,
Sara Connors
Head of Product Operations | AvaHealth
Sara.Connors@avahealth.com

Attachment: AVA-Vendor-Security-Questionnaire.pdf

To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Connors <sara.connors@avahealth.com>, Eric Ma <sec-qa@avahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:33:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Service map & data paths — follow-up from demo

Forwarding AVA's questionnaire and their clarifying questions — want to align on a short package we can send back.

Neha / Logan — can you help assemble the following by EOD Wednesday?
- SOC 2 status and a one-page summary (what we cover, date, any in-scope exclusions). Prefer a PDF: Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf.
- Minimal service map: compute regions, object storage providers, and which components may persist request payloads (logs, KV cache, analytics). A CSV roster for third parties is fine: cloud_roster_2027-06.csv.
- Suggested language for HIPAA/BAA if required and AVA-specific redlines for the questionnaire.

Proposed approach: Neha drafts answers inline in their PDF copy, Logan populates the cloud roster and a small diagram PNG. I will do a quick review and send to Sara + Eric. If we need exec sign-off for any unusual terms, I'll flag.

Thanks —
Camila

Camila / Logan / Sara / Eric — thanks for the clear asks. Initial plan and artifacts attached; will complete the inline questionnaire draft by EOD Wednesday as requested.

What we're sending now (attached):
- Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf — summary of our most recent SOC 2 Type II attestation (period ending 2027-03-31) and the in-scope controls.
- cloud_roster_2027-06.csv — short roster showing primary cloud compute (GCP us-west1 for hosted, customer-dedicated private pools may be in Azure us-east or on-prem per customer; object storage uses AWS S3 for backups in the US), plus monitoring and analytics vendors (Datadog, S3 lifecycle for logs).
- service-map-draft.png — simple data path highlighting where request payloads may transit or persist (KV cache for active sessions, short-lived logs for debugging retained 7 days by default, dedicated pools with optional log suppression).

Notes/answers to your bullets:
- SOC 2: We do have a SOC 2 Type II report (send attached summary now). Full report available under NDA; we can initiate an NDA if you need the full auditor report.
- Data residency: By default, telemetry/logging that includes minimally redacted metadata is stored in US regions. For PHI workloads we can configure dedicated pools and opt-out of telemetry collection; we've documented the configuration steps in the attached CSV.
- Third-party services: See cloud_roster_2027-06.csv for the short list. If AVA needs a more exhaustive supplier list (including specific SaaS subcomponents), we can expand to a full third-party inventory export — turnaround 5 business days.

Next steps: Neha will populate AVA's PDF with inline answers and proposed redlines (target EOD Wed). If AVA prefers, we can schedule a 30-min security Q&A next week to walk through the service map.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf, cloud_roster_2027-06.csv, service-map-draft.png

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0244
